company.name: AFS
company.shortDescription: AFS provides card processing, merchant acquiring, online fraud monitoring and leading payment solutions to financial sectors.
company.description: AFS offers a safe, secure, effective, and dependable management solution. AFS, which is equipped with the most recent IBM mainframe system, employs a cutting-edge backup and redundant storage system, as well as a fully working offshore disaster recovery center. AFS offers BPay, a digital wallet solution that allows individuals, businesses, and corporations to make and receive payments using their smartphones instead of cash or cards in an easy, fast, and secure manner. BPay exists to be the go-to app for digital payments, commerce, and financial services.
